SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, pa.application_id AS applicationId, NULL AS contractId,
p.title AS title, cu.name AS clientName,
pa.application_status AS applicationStatus, NULL AS contractStatus,
DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(p.deadline_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate,
NULL AS nextMilestoneName, NULL AS nextMilestoneDueDate, p.budget AS totalBudget, DATEDIFF(p.deadline_date, CURDATE()) AS dday, 0 AS progressPercent FROM project_applications pa JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pa.project_id JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = p.client_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{freelancerId} AND pa.application_status IN ('PENDING','VIEWED','CHATTING','OFFERED') ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC
